# PoC 2 cable schedule (generated by blueprint.py)

PoC 2 (TENTATIVE 'robust'): 7-node TG bowtie, 3 IP-50 rungs, 2 coupling arms, DPIR only. 201 cables.

Nodes are managed in-band (E2E controller over the radio network); no node ETH2 or IP-50 management port is cabled. IF cable lengths come from the rack span: vertical distance + horizontal port offset + 100 mm, rounded up to a stock length; confirm at install.
